data.one_liner: Embeds Git commit, branch, and build metadata into Flutter apps with optional UI screens.
data.what_it_does: Generates Dart files containing git information (commit SHA, branch, build date) via a CLI command. Provides await-less access to build information and optional debugging UI screens to inspect commit history and package details.
use_when: You need to easily track which Git commit and branch are deployed in a test or production build.
You want an in-app debug screen to view build metadata, commit lists, and change history.
avoid_when: You are not using Git for version control.
You do not want to run a CLI generation step before building your app.
strengths: Provides immediate await-less access to build and git metadata.
Includes helpful built-in UI components and pages for debugging and viewing git history.
weaknesses: Requires running a CLI command to generate files during the build process.
Tightly couples app code to a Git repository context.
data.setup_notes: Run `dart run git_stamp --build-type full` to generate the necessary files in your project.
